description: The benchmark hardcore hardtail, now upgraded with premium trail components. Built around Orange's renowned 6061-T6 custom butted aluminium frame, the Crush combines modern, confidence-inspiring geometry with a lively ride that's equally at home on technical singletrack, trail centres and all-day adventures. This brand-new clearance bike has been upgraded with a RockShox Lyrik Base 140mm fork, Stan's NoTubes S2 rims on Strange hubs, and Continental Kryptotal tyres, delivering improved control, durability and grip over the original specification.
